description: fp32 rank of the sign-coded argmax doc-token, among flipped low-margin q-tokens (margin<0.2, preserved=False), aug 100k r=64 random-orth.
reading: substitute is usually NOT the runner-up (only 18.9% land at rank 2; 38.7% land beyond rank 10; median rank 7) yet the score residual is near zero -- the low-margin head is a dense plateau, so rank is a misleading lens and the score residual is the right one.
